discovered_by: claude-fable-5 + local playwright (capture.py) + httpx header-ablation probes
notes: lifeattiktok.com/search is a Next.js SPA; job data comes from POST api.lifeattiktok.com/api/v1/public/supplier/search/job/posts (JSON body), NOT from HTML or embedded JSON.

The ONLY load-bearing header is 'website-path: tiktok' — without it the API returns HTTP 400 'invalid request'; with it alone (no UA/Origin/Referer) it returns 200. Ablation-tested one header at a time on 2026-08-05.

Pagination: 'offset'/'limit' in the POST body; replay.py merges the offset param into the JSON body for POST entrypoints. limit up to at least 2000 is honored; 1000 chosen for ~4.6MB responses and headroom. Past-the-end offsets return a short page, which terminates the loop.

data.count is the site's own total (3799 at discovery); expected_min_jobs=2000 (~53% of that) so a silent geo-filter, pagination regression, or portal split fails loudly instead of half-scraping — the exact failure mode of the 3,582-job false-closure incident.
Records carry no posting/created timestamp (job_post_info.expiry_time exists but was null everywhere sampled) — freshness must be inferred by diffing runs.
Job detail page URL is https://lifeattiktok.com/search/<id> (confirmed via the site's own RSC prefetches); the API does not return a URL field, so fields.url is a template.

Playwright could not see the POST body (post_data=null, streamed); body was reconstructed from the 132-byte content-length + ByteDance careers API conventions and verified byte-exact via httpx (identical response: 12 jobs, count 3799).
